note: Retrieval catalog for the Interaction Trigger Policy. This is not a second rule store and is not a write API. Looking up a rule, running a forward-scan, or producing a consolidation report must not create or rewrite Interaction records.
write_policy: retrieve broadly, write conservatively, additive versioned history
history_policy: When a write is justified, append or version; do not destructively overwrite prior rule states. Consolidation emits review candidates only.

rules.title: Detecting a missing architecture node
prompt_patterns: should this have its own node
official page links to a component
rules.reusable_rule: Distinguish missing source vs missing relationship vs missing architecture node vs already-existing content, then apply the smallest necessary update.
rules.response_strategy: Search Records, Sources, and Architecture References before creating anything new.

rules.title: Synchronization transparency
rules.reusable_rule: Distinguish actually executed externally, planned only, not yet written, and waiting for authorization.
rules.response_strategy: Do not imply external persistence without actual tool execution.

rules.title: Duplicate detection when record number is forgotten
prompt_patterns: not sure of the record number
rules.reusable_rule: Compare core propositions before creating a new record. If highly overlapping, preserve the canonical record.
rules.response_strategy: Create a duplicate relationship instead of incrementing a new ID.

rules.title: Assistant judgment as retrievable interaction data
rules.reusable_rule: Store shareable judgment summaries and retrieve similar interaction rules before deciding. Version on conflict instead of overwriting.
rules.response_strategy: Retrieve similar rules first; keep public de-identified summaries only.

rules.title: Automatic interaction retrieval and write gating
problem_types: interaction treated as a passive log
prompt_patterns: do not create an interaction for every event
rules.reusable_rule: Run the Trigger Router first. Retrieve similar rules before writing. Retrieval never creates a record. Prefer update/versioning over CREATE_NEW. Write only when the write gate is satisfied, and then additively.
rules.response_strategy: Classify each meaningful event; leave Interaction Learning unchanged unless a reusable rule must be created, versioned, or reviewed.

versions.note: Canonical routing layer: retrieve broadly, write conservatively; retrieval is not persistence.

rules.title: Structure-first user reasoning signal
prompt_patterns: these two things should stay separate
I don't know the database terms
rules.reusable_rule: Detect structural meaning before looking for technical vocabulary. Ordinary-language structure signals are retrieval triggers. Do not require the user to translate them into code or schema terms.
rules.response_strategy: Retrieve first from structural meaning. Retrieval does not persist. If a reusable rule changes, version additively.

versions.note: Canonical structure-first rule: natural-language structural observations trigger retrieval/review without technical translation.

rules.title: Proactive synthesis instead of toothpaste-style interaction
prompt_patterns: do not silently rewrite historical rules
I have to catch the next missing piece
rules.reusable_rule: When a structural correction is detected, perform a local forward-scan before responding. Return current issue, likely adjacent issues, recommended combined change, what should remain unchanged, and any maintenance implication. Prefer one compact batch when confidence is sufficient. Bundle uncertain items as review candidates. Because Interaction Learning is additive/versioned, run periodic consolidation without silently rewriting historical rules.
rules.response_strategy: Scan adjacent dependencies, downstream gaps, and related Interaction rules before replying. Consolidate near-duplicates, superseded rules, conflict clusters, and merge candidates into review reports rather than destructive overwrites.

versions.note: Canonical optimization rule: local forward scan plus periodic consolidation; history remains additive.
